_note: Draw-only stretch per axis (model x = width, y = height, z = depth) for prop types whose converted original model does not fill the collider Godot derived from its blocky model (render/prop_scale.rs `axis_scale`; baked into the model's vertices once when it is loaded, render/prop_model.rs). It multiplies on top of the uniform data/render/prop_draw_scale.json value. Colliders, footprints, placement and the generator's seat heights do not read this file. Every model of a listed type is stretched; a value must be between 0.25 and 4.
